Novig pregame: no fee. hardrock_latest/_first: Hard Rock sportsbook price and line via The Odds API (no order book; refreshed every 30 min). best_now = best gettable price across the books, plus total dollars at the alert price or better on books with the exact line. Novig fields: best_price = cheapest cost to BUY the alert side now (0-1, with American); dollars_at_alert_price_or_better = dollars you could buy at the alert's price or better on the same line; exact_line=false means Novig had no market at the alert's line and the nearest line is shown. resting_bids_on_this_side_dollars = others bidding the same side. 'first' = first check after the alert, 'latest' = this run. Novig orders are bids (verified Oct 21).
